name: Kasuga-taisha
heritage: National Treasure of Japan; Historic Site of Japan; part of UNESCO World Heritage Site
type: chokusaisha; Shinto shrine; Kasuga shrine (worship); Shikinaisha; Shrines receiving Tsukinami-sai and Niiname-sai offerings; Shikinai Supershrine; taisha
text: Kasuga-taisha (春日大社) is a Shinto shrine in Nara, Nara Prefecture, Japan. It is the shrine of the Fujiwara family, established in 768 CE and rebuilt several times over the centuries. The interior is famous for its many bronze lanterns, as well as the many stone lanterns that lead up to the shrine.
